description: This file defines the CachesConfig interface which provides configuration settings for various caches in the Concierge service, including timeout durations and cache configurations. It also contains an enumeration for known configuration path expressions and their default values.

classes.name: CachesConfig
classes.description: An interface that specifies configuration methods for caches used within the Concierge service, including timeout and cache configuration accessors.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for entity shard regions.

methods.name: getIdCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the ID cache.

methods.name: getEnforcerCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the enforcer cache.

classes.name: CachesConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue, representing known configuration path expressions and default values for CachesConfig settings.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the config path.
